The main takeaway from our work is that
the current inter-domain peering models for Layer 2 and optical networks do not provide the required flexibility to meet the dynamic traffic demands.

there is a need for a unified inter-domain control plane that can be used to interwork with the existing Internet routing protocols and can be used to provision end-to-end QoS guaranteed paths across different domains.

the current Internet routing protocols, such as Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) and Multi Protocol Label Switching (MPLS) can be used for multi-domain peering and dynamic provisioning in Layer 2 networks, but the same cannot be extended for WDM switched networks.
